input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Plays Well with Others"?

documents.text: Plays Well with Others (Greg Koch album) Plays Well with Others is a studio album by American guitarist Greg Koch. Released in 2013. Several accomplished and well known musicians performed on this album with Greg Koch. This album including guitarists: Joe Bonamassa Robben Ford, Paul Barrère. Roscoe Beck was featured on bass and Jon Cleary on piano.
